|.macro x64_vm_gc_should_step, g, tmp, target
|  mov tmp, [g+GL_OFS(gc.total)]	// TSO acquire load: lj_gc_total_load().
|  cmp tmp, [g+GL_OFS(gc.threshold)]	// TSO acquire load: lj_gc_threshold_load().
|  jae target
|  mov tmp, [g+GL_OFS(gc2.alloc_since_trigger)]  // TSO acquire load.
|  cmp tmp, [g+GL_OFS(gc2.hard_bytes)]  // lj_gc2_hard_limit_reached().
|  jbe >7
|  cmp qword [g+GL_OFS(gc2.hard_bytes)], LJ_GC2_ACCT_FLUSH
|  jb target
|  // Mirror gc_hard_assist_due_interp(): normal hard assists wait until the
|  // current thread group has enough local allocation debt to flush.
|  cmp qword [DISPATCH+DISPATCH_TG(local_total)], LJ_GC2_ACCT_FLUSH
|  jae target
|7:
|.endmacro
|.macro x64_vm_tstore_direct_ok, target
|  cmp TGMARK, 0
